name: Capital A Berhad
overview: 2026年，Capital A Berhad 完成对休眠子公司 AAD Holdings Inc. 的自愿清算，并获 upliftment of PN17 状态；公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新业务或合约。
overview_en: In 2026, Capital A Berhad completed the members' voluntary liquidation of its dormant subsidiary AAD Holdings Inc. and obtained upliftment of its PN17 status; the company did not disclose any segment expansion, new business, or contracts in its announcements.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 今年完成休眠子公司 AAD Holdings Inc. 的自愿清算，并获 upliftment of PN17 状态。
segments.note_en: This year, the company completed the members' voluntary liquidation of dormant subsidiary AAD Holdings Inc. and obtained upliftment of its PN17 status.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: AAD Holdings Inc. 的清算完成，不再为子公司。
actions.text_en: The liquidation of AAD Holdings Inc. was completed and it ceased to be a subsidiary.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: AAD Holdings Inc.（休眠全资子公司）启动成员自愿清算程序。
actions.text_en: AAD Holdings Inc., a dormant wholly-owned subsidiary, commenced members' voluntary winding-up proceedings.

actions.title: CAPITAL A BERHAD - UPLIFTMENT OF PN17 STATUS
actions.text: 公司获 upliftment of PN17 状态。
actions.text_en: The company obtained upliftment of its PN17 status.
